text:
Maria (product): Quick sync — v2 rollout scope. Need decisions on backward-compat behavior for chat/completions, embeddings, rerank, tool/function calling, and structured output. Customer asks: keep v1 stable while v2 introduces structured outputs + stricter tool semantics. Can we avoid doubling maintenance?

Sam (eng): Short answer: doable but not free. We can add a router-level shim that maps v1 shapes to v2 shapes. Tradeoffs: extra CPU on the edge, more unit tests, and longer rollout windows for canary. Prefer an opt-in compatibility header so we don't pay for all traffic.

Li (devex): +1 for a header. Suggest `x-rdwd-compat: v1` to enable shim behavior. Devex will own migration guides and SDK helpers if eng defines deterministic mappings for older params.

Tess (CS): FYI — FinX and MedStream asked for a 12-month deprecation window and for the shim to be "silent" (i.e., not add new `metadata` fields unless the client opts in). They can't flip quickly.

Sam (eng): Proposed router pseudo-code for the shim:
```
if req.headers['x-rdwd-compat']== 'v1':
  // map old tool param -> new functions list
  req.body.functions = req.body.tools || req.body.tool_calls || []
  // flatten structured outputs back to plain text when needed
  resp.body = normalizeToV1Shape(resp.body)
```
This keeps a single v2 runtime but preserves v1 surface. We'll need feature-flagging around the normalization to iterate safely.

Maria (product): Launch criteria suggestion (must-have before GA):
- migration docs + step-by-step SDK examples
- automated translator tests (unit + integration) with sample customer prompts
- perf guardrails: p95 latency regressions <= 2% and error rate impact <= 0.5% during canary
- canary with 1% traffic -> 10% -> 50% cadence + automated rollback
- console banner + email ready for top 50 orgs
Please call out any blockers.

Li (devex): We can deliver an initial migration SDK and a CLI linter to flag deprecated params. ETA: docs + SDK helper PR in 10 business days if eng provides mapping table this week.

Sam (eng): Technical blockers to call out:
- Tool/function semantics: v2 supports async tool results and typed schemas. For compat we must stringify structured results or include an opt-out mapping.
- Rerank/embeddings: v2 slightly changes the embed vector normalization. We'll add a compatibility toggle that applies the old normalization when `x-rdwd-compat: v1` is present.
- Edge cases: prompt-engineered prefixes (prefix caching) — mapping could change caching behavior; need to include cache-busting tests.

Tess (CS): Communication plan: targeted emails + in-console migration checklist + changelog entry. Also propose a "migration office hours" slot next week for high-touch customers. I can run that.

deploy-bot: :robot_face: Canary rollout scheduled: 2026-04-05T16:00:00Z (1% traffic), canary window = 48h, auto-rollforward if perf ok.

Maria (product): Ok — owners and next steps:
- Sam: produce mapping table for all v1->v2 param/response differences (due in 3 business days)
- Li: draft SDK helpers + migration guide PR (ETA 10 business days)
- Tess: owner for comms + office hours invite (due 2 business days)
- Eng + Devex: define tests & perf harness for canary (ready before 04/05)
If anyone sees a blocker to these deadlines speak up now.

Sam (eng): A couple of notes: we'll need a short-lived telemetry flag to detect shim usage and errors. Also recommend we gate silent transformations behind a "preserve_v1_shape" toggle for first month.

Li (devex): We'll add a migration checklist item that says: `Set header: x-rdwd-compat: v1` and sample curl + SDK snippet. Will add CLI linter rule for deprecated fields too.

Tess (CS): I'll notify FinX and MedStream and invite them to office hours. Also will ask legal for any contractual notes on 12-month deprecation.

Maria (product): Great. We'll treat the shim as temporary long-tail support and bake dev signals to retire it after 12 months, subject to adoption. Recording owners and deadlines in the roadmap item now. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
